notes_for_editor: Thin record. Read: the FFLOS register page, the Forest Lookouts Alabama stub (name, county, agency only), the OpenStreetMap node (name and tags only) and the 2019 Alabama report by the nominator, which is general and does not name Aquilla. Nothing found on build date, staffing, fires, removal or condition, and no access statement. The brief's 'gone' status rests on the register's former-site category; no removal record was found. OpenStreetMap gives the point an elevation of 142 m against the register's 146 m; the difference is small and unexplained, so it is not in the story. Worth trying: Choctaw County newspapers, Alabama Forestry Commission records (the AFC has a public records policy), and a message to the nominator, who wrote in 2019 that he was seeking photos and stories of former lookouts from local history societies. The Flickr set of Choctaw County towers was not read. No corrections proposed.
